paite: Kumpipa lungtang TOUPA khut a om ahi, tui lampite bang in; a-utna lamlam ah ahei hi.
Mihing lampi chiteng amah mit ah adik a; himahleh TOUPA'N lungtangte abuk hi.
Diktatna leh vaihawmna hih kithoihna sang in TOUPA a ding in alaktakzaw hi.
Mit hah sang leh lungtang kisathei, migilou khawnvak nangawn, khelhna ahi.
Mipil ngaihtuahnate'n hauhsakna lam kia anawt a; himahleh michih kinohhat taksapna lam kia ah akinoh hi.
Lei zuauthei agou muh tuimei lehlam lehlam a mutleng bang ahi; huaite zong mite'n sihna azong uhi.
Migilou hiamgamna in amaute ataimang ding; vaihawmna hih anial ziak un.
Amah mohna a dimpa lampi akawi mahmah a; himahleh misiangthou ahihleh, athilhih adik ahi.
Inn zapi sung a numei selhat toh ten sang in, intung vum ning a ten ahoihzaw.
Migilou kha in hoih lou adeih; a-invengte in amit ah deihsakna atang kei hi.
Muhsit hatmi gawt a a-om chiang in, mimawl bawlpil in a-om hi; huan mipil hilh a a-om chiang in, theihna amu hi.
Midiktat in migilou inkuan angaihtuah; migiloute amau siatna ding in vuallel a a-omdan uh.
Kuapeuh genthei kahna a bil hum, amah leng akap ding, himahleh zak in a-om kei ding hi.
Aguk a thilpiak in hehna anemzou, huan angsung a van tawi in hehna mahmah.
Midiktat a ding in vaihawmna hih kipahna ahi, himahleh thulim lou hihte a ding in siatna ahi.
Theihsiamna lampi a kipan vakmangmi misite kikhopna ah akhawl ding.
Kuapeuh nopbawlna it migenthei ahi ding; kuapeuh uain leh sathau hai ahau kei ding uh.
Migilou midiktat a ding in tatna sum ahi a, huan mitang mun ah milepchiah ahong pai hi.
Numei kisel hat leh kinak hat kiang sang in gamkeu a ten ahoihzaw.
Mipil tenna ah gou leh sathau manpha a-om; himahleh mihai in huai anawmvalh vek hi.
Kuapeuh diktatna leh zahngaihna delh in hinna, diktatna leh zahtakhuaina amu ding hi.
Mipil mihatte khopi ah akah a, huai lai a muanna hatna aphel hi.
Kuapeuh kamsim a, pau lou in buainate a kipan akha akemhoih hi.
Mikisathei leh uang, amin muhsit hat ahi, kisaktheihna leh ki-otsakna in thil ahih zel hi.
Thadahmi deih in amah athat a; akhutte'n sepgim anial ngal uh.
Nitum a duhgawltak a huaiham a-om a; himahleh midiktat in apia a, a-it kei hi.
Migilou kithoihna kihhuai ahi, lungsim gilou toh huai ahon tawi chiang in, bangchi phet a kihhuai sem ahi diam aw!
Theihpih zuauthei amangthang ding; himahleh azami in kalh vual louh in thu agen ding.
Migilou in amaitang a taksak a himahleh mitang ahihleh bel, alampite abawlhoih hi.
TOUPA kalh in pilna hiam theihsiamna hiam thupha hiam a-om kei hi.
Kidou ni a ding in sakol bawlsa ahi; himahleh vualzohna TOUPA a ahi.
